title: September 6, 2026
description: Discover how you can now train your own custom AI model right from your laptop without the need for expensive cloud GPUs! A solo engineer from Kazakhstan has developed an innovative open-source tool called Soup that changes the game for AI enthusiasts and developers alike. Traditionally, fine-tuning large language models required renting costly cloud GPU time, writing complex Python scripts, and struggling with lengthy debugging processes—often making it inaccessible for many. Soup simplifies everything: just write a simple YAML config file, point it to your training data, and run a single command. The tool cleverly loads and trains the model one layer at a time, drastically reducing GPU memory requirements from 16 GB to just 3.3 GB. In fact, some users have even tested Soup on a 4 GB laptop GPU, achieving production-grade performance close to 119 tokens per second! This breakthrough went viral on Hacker News and is completely free to use.
